title: Ezekiel 39: The Fall of Gog and the Gathering of Israel
body:
Read the chapter → [Ezekiel 39](/bible/ezekiel/39)

This session of "4 Chapters a Day" covers [Ezekiel 39](/bible/ezekiel/39) through 42. [Ezekiel 39](/bible/ezekiel/39) finishes the prophecy against Gog, the chief prince of Meshech, whom the Most High brings against the mountains of Israel only to break his weapons, bury his multitude, and glorify His own name before the heathen. Chapters 40 through 42 turn to the vision of the temple, where a man with a measuring reed shows Ezekiel the courts, gates, chambers, and the most holy place. The teacher sets all of this as future prophecy: it comes to pass after Christ has taken down the nations and Israel dwells again in their own land, when the Most High gathers His people out of their captivity and the temple is established once more.

**[Ezekiel 39:1-3](/bible/ezekiel/39#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/ezekiel/39#v1)</sup> Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/ezekiel/39#v2)</sup> And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/ezekiel/39#v3)</sup> And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.

- Gog is the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and Magog is the land of Russia. Whoever comes out of the land of southern Georgia and Russia we know from the scriptures is Esau. This is all prophecy, going forward to the time after Christ has taken down the other nations, when Israel will be in their land.
- This is the same setting as [Revelation 20](/bible/revelation/20), when Satan is loosed in both the spiritual and the physical form: the spiritual demon Satan and the physical Esau. The Most High smites the bow out of Gog's left hand and causes his arrows to fall out of his right hand, so no weapon formed against Israel will prosper. He smacks their weapons out of their hand and their weapon is for naught.
  - **[Ezekiel 38:1-6](/bible/ezekiel/38#v1)**
    > <sup>[1](/bible/ezekiel/38#v1)</sup> And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
    >
    > <sup>[2](/bible/ezekiel/38#v2)</sup> Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
    >
    > <sup>[3](/bible/ezekiel/38#v3)</sup> And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
    >
    > <sup>[4](/bible/ezekiel/38#v4)</sup> And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:
    >
    > <sup>[5](/bible/ezekiel/38#v5)</sup> Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:
    >
    > <sup>[6](/bible/ezekiel/38#v6)</sup> Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.

    The armies gathered with Gog are named, Persia, Ethiopia, Libya, Gomer, and Togarmah, showing Esau conspiring to draw all the other nations to come against Israel.
  - **[Revelation 20:7](/bible/revelation/20#v7)**
    > <sup>[7](/bible/revelation/20#v7)</sup> And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

    Satan being loosed at the end of the thousand years is the same moment this prophecy against Gog describes.

**[Ezekiel 39:4-7](/bible/ezekiel/39#v4)**

> <sup>[4](/bible/ezekiel/39#v4)</sup> Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/ezekiel/39#v5)</sup> Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.
>
> <sup>[6](/bible/ezekiel/39#v6)</sup> And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the Lord.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/ezekiel/39#v7)</sup> So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, the Holy One in Israel.

- Gog and all his bands fall upon the mountains of Israel, meaning they will not succeed. They are given to the ravenous birds and the beasts of the field to be devoured. This lets us know it is future prophecy, because we are still in captivity today and this has not happened yet.
- The Most High sends a fire on Magog and among them that dwell carelessly, and He establishes His name. Just as He did in Egypt, Israel will know again that it is the Lord, He will not let them pollute His holy name anymore, and the heathen shall know that He is the Holy One in Israel.

**[Ezekiel 39:8-10](/bible/ezekiel/39#v8)**

> <sup>[8](/bible/ezekiel/39#v8)</sup> Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord God; this is the day whereof I have spoken.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/ezekiel/39#v9)</sup> And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:
>
> <sup>[10](/bible/ezekiel/39#v10)</sup> So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord God.

- The day the Most High has spoken of comes to pass, and those who dwell in the cities of Israel go forth and burn the weapons, the shields, bows, arrows, hand staves, and spears, with fire seven years. Their weapons are taken from them; they will be beaten into submission and forced to work the land instead of making war.
- Israel takes no wood out of the field because they burn the weapons for fuel, and they spoil those that spoiled them and rob those that robbed them. It is a turning: those who took from us, we take from them.
  - **[Joel 3:9](/bible/joel/3#v9)**
    > <sup>[9](/bible/joel/3#v9)</sup> Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:

    The heathen are gathered to the valley of Jehoshaphat where the Most High sits to judge, the reverse of beating weapons into farm tools.
  - **[Isaiah 60:11](/bible/isaiah/60#v11)**
    > <sup>[11](/bible/isaiah/60#v11)</sup> Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.

    Israel's gates stand open continually so the forces and wealth of the gentiles may be brought in and their kings serve as servants.

**[Ezekiel 39:11-16](/bible/ezekiel/39#v11)**

> <sup>[11](/bible/ezekiel/39#v11)</sup> And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamon–gog.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/ezekiel/39#v12)</sup> And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/ezekiel/39#v13)</sup> Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord God.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/ezekiel/39#v14)</sup> And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/ezekiel/39#v15)</sup> And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon–gog.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/ezekiel/39#v16)</sup> And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

- The Most High gives Gog a place of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea, and it is called the valley of Hamongog. They are put to death and buried there.
- For seven months the house of Israel buries them to cleanse the land, and that day is a day of renown when the Most High is glorified. Men of continual employment are set apart to pass through the land, and when they find a man's bones they set up a sign until the buriers bury it, and the city is called Hamonah.

**[Ezekiel 39:17-20](/bible/ezekiel/39#v17)**

> <sup>[17](/bible/ezekiel/39#v17)</sup> And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord God; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/ezekiel/39#v18)</sup> Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/ezekiel/39#v19)</sup> And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/ezekiel/39#v20)</sup> Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord God.

- The Most High tells Ezekiel to speak to every feathered fowl and every beast of the field to gather to His sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that they may eat flesh and drink blood. There will be a great slaughter in that day.
- They eat the flesh of the mighty and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, lambs, goats, and bullocks, until they are full and drunken at His table with horses, chariots, and all men of war.

**[Ezekiel 39:21-24](/bible/ezekiel/39#v21)**

> <sup>[21](/bible/ezekiel/39#v21)</sup> And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.
>
> <sup>[22](/bible/ezekiel/39#v22)</sup> So the house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord their God from that day and forward.
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/ezekiel/39#v23)</sup> And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.
>
> <sup>[24](/bible/ezekiel/39#v24)</sup> According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.

- The Most High sets His glory among the heathen, and all the heathen see the judgment He has executed. Right now the Lord is not glorified in this kingdom, but in that day He will be, and He gets His people's attention. Today the world calls the heathen's works great, their space programs and their weapons of mass destruction, but when the Most High shuts all that down we will realize who the real power is.
- From that day the house of Israel knows that He is the Lord their God, and the heathen know that Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they trespassed against Him. That is why we are in the position we are in; He hid His face and gave us into the hand of our enemies because we did not obey.

**[Ezekiel 39:25-29](/bible/ezekiel/39#v25)**

> <sup>[25](/bible/ezekiel/39#v25)</sup> Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;
>
> <sup>[26](/bible/ezekiel/39#v26)</sup> After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.
>
> <sup>[27](/bible/ezekiel/39#v27)</sup> When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;
>
> <sup>[28](/bible/ezekiel/39#v28)</sup> Then shall they know that I am the Lord their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.
>
> <sup>[29](/bible/ezekiel/39#v29)</sup> Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord God.

- Now the Most High brings again the captivity of Jacob and has mercy upon the whole house of Israel, upon those who repent and endure to the end. He is jealous for His holy name after they have borne their shame.
- He gathers them out of their enemies' land, as we are being gathered today from the four corners of the earth, and He is sanctified in them in the sight of many nations. The heathen had nothing to do with our captivity; it was the Lord's will, and no one can resist the will of the Lord. He leaves none of them among the heathen anymore, and He will not hide His face anymore, for He has poured out His spirit upon the house of Israel.
  - **[Isaiah 43:21](/bible/isaiah/43#v21)**
    > <sup>[21](/bible/isaiah/43#v21)</sup> This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

    Israel is the people the Most High formed for Himself to show forth His praise, which is fulfilled as they return to His law before the nations.
